page.title: Location Definitions
page.description: Manage the warehouse zone, aisle, rack, level and bin hierarchy.
page.warehouseOpeningAction: Warehouse Opening with a Single Excel File

shelfImport.title: Initial Shelf Definition Import with Excel
shelfImport.description: Create the shelf hierarchy in a single file using a safe, create-only import.
shelfImport.warning: Existing shelves are not updated or deleted. The entire import is stopped if the same warehouse/shelf code already exists.

warehouseOpening.title: Warehouse Opening with a Single Excel File
warehouseOpening.description: Create the shelf hierarchy and initial stock, lot and serial balances with controlled imports of up to 50,000 rows.
warehouseOpening.atomicImportDescription: The complete file is validated first. Records are committed in short 500-row transaction batches; after an interruption, uploading the same file resumes without duplicating completed batches.
warehouseOpening.downloadTemplateDescription: The template includes warehouse and shelf references, plus the first 5,000 stock/configuration records as examples. You can also type valid codes not shown in the list directly; pre-validation checks them against the system.

replacement.title: Reconcile existing balances with Excel
replacement.description: Excel will be treated as the definitive balance snapshot for the selected warehouses. Movement history is preserved. Stock, location, serial and lot quantities found in Excel are adjusted to the file values; existing balances omitted from the file are brought to zero with auditable difference movements. Do not post other warehouse movements during this operation.
replacement.reservationBlocked: Reconciliation cannot start: {{quantity}} is reserved by open orders. Complete the orders or release their reservations first.

warehouseOpening.importCompleteSummary: {{created}} new shelves and {{balances}} balance rows were processed.

form.description: Manage address hierarchy, usage rules and capacity.
form.usageRulesDescription: These choices are operational controls, not informational flags. They determine how this location is used for putaway, picking, quality, quarantine and counting. Compare the Enabled and Disabled outcomes on every card before saving.
form.codeHint: Letters and numbers may be combined with /, -, . and _. Example: A01/R01-G01
form.name: Location name

rules.mixedStock: Can different stock codes share this location?
rules.mixedLot: Can different lots of the same stock share this location?
rules.mixedStatus: Can different inventory statuses share this location?
rules.cycleCount: Can this location be included in a count plan?
rules.pickable: Can products be picked from this location?
rules.putaway: Can products be put away into this location?
rules.quarantine: Is this a quarantine / reject location?
rules.active: Can this location be used in new operations?

mixedStock.enabled: Multiple different stock codes may be stored in this location at the same time.
mixedStock.disabled: The location follows a single-stock layout and is not suggested for another stock when occupied.
mixedStock.affects: Post-receipt location suggestions, putaway and location organization.

mixedLot.enabled: Different lots of the same stock may be stored together in this location.
mixedLot.disabled: The location is marked for a single-lot layout; different lots should use separate locations.
mixedLot.affects: Lot traceability, putaway organization and count control.

mixedStatus.enabled: Available, quality-hold or quarantine inventory statuses may coexist in this location.
mixedStatus.disabled: The location should contain one inventory status; quality-hold and available stock are separated.
mixedStatus.affects: Quality, quarantine, available balance and location organization.

cycleCount.enabled: The location can be added to count plans and receive count tasks.
cycleCount.disabled: The location is excluded from new count orders and count-location selectors.
cycleCount.affects: Cycle counts, ad-hoc counts and count-order creation.

pickable.enabled: Shipment, transfer and production picking orders may consume available stock from this location.
pickable.disabled: The location is not offered as a picking source; keep this disabled for quality-hold and quarantine locations.
pickable.affects: Picking, shipment, warehouse transfer and production transfer.

putaway.enabled: This location may be selected as a target after receipt, transfer or quality acceptance.
putaway.disabled: The location is not used as a normal putaway target; receiving, staging or virtual areas may keep it disabled.
putaway.affects: Putaway, post-receipt placement, transfer and quality acceptance.

quarantine.enabled: The location may be targeted by quality quarantine and reject decisions. Picking is switched off automatically.
quarantine.disabled: The location is a normal operation location and cannot be selected as a quality quarantine / reject target.
quarantine.affects: Quality inspection, quarantine, rejection and inventory-status movements.

active.enabled: The location is available in new operations, searches and eligible selectors.
active.disabled: The location cannot be used in new operations; existing balances and movement history are retained.
active.affects: All warehouse operations, location searches and source / target selectors.

validation.requiredBasic: Warehouse, location code and location name are required.
validation.invalidCode: The location code must start with a letter or number. Use only letters, numbers, /, -, . and _; maximum 50 characters.
validation.parentRequired: Select a valid parent location for aisle, rack, shelf level and bin types.
validation.barcodeRequired: Barcode is required in manual barcode mode.
validation.capacityUnitRequired: Capacity unit is required when a capacity value is entered.
